    Frequently Asked Questions

    How does fixation reading work on an e-reader?

    The human eye reads by jumping between anchor fixation points (saccades). By bolding the first few letters of every word, your eye latches onto words faster, reducing subvocalization and eye fatigue on e-ink screens.

    How do I get the converted file onto my Kindle?

    Amazon supports standard EPUBs through amazon.com/sendtokindle or via your Kindle's personal email address. Amazon automatically delivers the converted EPUB wirelessly to your device.

    Does this work with DRM-protected books?

    Inkbolt processes standard, DRM-free EPUB and PDF documents. If your e-book is locked with Adobe or Amazon DRM, remove the DRM using tools like Calibre with DeDRM before converting.
